user_request: Вот но давай чють ближе к kingdom rush
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer.
Asset type: subtle refinement of an existing tiny-pixel isometric tactical battlefield.
Edit the attached image. The user has selected THIS EXACT IMAGE as the preferred base, and now says: "This, but a little closer to Kingdom Rush." Their previous requirement still applies: keep the characters in the SAME pixel style as the terrain tiles. Produce ONE final full-board scene.
PRESERVE: the entire floating diamond square-tiled board, original grass/sand/stone arrangement, water streams, tile geometry, pixel step, colors, tiny grass plants, exposed vertical sides, plain plum background, exact framing and camera. Preserve the six characters' positions, team arrangement and SMALL ORIGINAL FOOTPRINTS. Do not enlarge them. Do not add terrain decorations or alter the board.
CHANGE ONLY THE SIX CHARACTERS, by one modest notch toward the recognizable Kingdom Rush designs. Keep simple large flat pixel clusters, hard staircase contours, limited 3-tone shading, matching the tile-scale pixel density. This is NOT a return to a detailed smooth cartoon. Think tiny game sprites with a few clever extra pixels, not big illustrated miniatures.
At left middle, Sir Gerald Lightseeker: a more recognizable swept cobalt-blue helmet plume, slightly broader angular shoulder plates, silver knight helmet with a narrow expressive visor, blue tabard/cape and shield, one small gold hilt/belt accent, short clear sword. His heroic identity reads at tiny size through silhouette; no decorative heraldry, no tiny rivets.
At upper left, Alleria Swiftwind: an emphatic but small blonde ponytail swept backward in one or two blocky shapes, pointed elf ear, forest-green triangular cape, brown recurve bow and quiver, simple focused face with a tiny dark brow/eye mark. Keep her compact and agile, feet on her original tile.
At lower left, Magnus Spellbane: upright swept dark hair, a clearly visible raised cream-and-gold angular collar, purple robes, ONE small purple chest gem, a tiny dark goatee patch, gold staff and small flat violet orb. No wizard hat or white beard. A tiny stern brow/eye mark makes the face read, no elaborate facial rendering.
Upper right orc: the same small helmeted axe orc, but an angular broad green jaw, tiny ivory tusks, stern simple eye/brow marks and clearer blocky shoulder/body silhouette. Two right-side goblins: pointed noses, broad triangular ears, mischievous small eye marks and tiny simple knife silhouettes, still smaller than the heroes.
The extra personality must come from silhouette, a few face pixels and recognizable gear shapes. NO fine contour lines, NO smooth vector ink, NO soft 3D modeling, NO gradient shading on characters, NO microtexture or noise, NO particles, NO magic flames, NO bloom, NO enlarging figures, NO circular oval shadow blobs. Keep coarse dark aubergine/brown pixel contours and flat color clusters at the SAME visual density as the supplied units. Characters may gain only a little detail. Existing scale and terrain style take priority.
No text, labels, UI, logo, watermark, split panel or inset. One landscape 1536x1024 image.
